Which term names the equilibrium condition in which an object remains at rest while all force vectors sum to zero?

  3. unbalanced motion

canonical_seed.solution_text: Static equilibrium means zero net force while the object remains at rest.

canonical_seed.student_text: A delivery cart moves straight at constant speed. The motor pulls 46 N to the right. Using the equilibrium rule, determine the leftward resistance.
canonical_seed.student_html:
A delivery cart moves straight at constant speed. The motor pulls 46 N to the right. Using the equilibrium rule, determine the leftward resistance.

\(\Sigma F = 0\)

  1. 46 N left
  2. 46 N in the same direction as the given force
  3. 0 N because equilibrium means no forces
  4. 92 N

choices.text: 46 N in the same direction as the given force
0 N because equilibrium means no forces

canonical_seed.solution_text: Constant straight-line velocity or rest means equilibrium, so the net force is zero. The required balancing force is 46 N left.
canonical_seed.solution_html: Constant straight-line velocity or rest means equilibrium, so the net force is zero. The required balancing force is 46 N left.
